reviews.name: Tristan M.
reviews.text:
I met Jerry in 2018 while I was working on my private pilot certificate. The first time I saw him, he was sitting in the office playing guitar. Honestly, it made me a little nervous because he seemed so relaxed, and I wondered what kind of instructor he was going to be. Once we got into the airplane, I immediately understood. Playing guitar was simply how he relaxed before his next student arrived—and that student was me. When the lesson began, he was focused, knowledgeable, and completely engaged.

Jerry is patient and willing to explain something slowly or approach it several different ways when you do not understand it the first time. Because he has so much experience, he can explain not only what you are learning, but why it is taught that way, how it applies in real flying, and when you may actually need it.

He does not just teach you how to perform maneuvers or pass a checkride. He teaches you to think before you act, ask questions, and weigh the risks before every flight. Jerry has been my instructor since 2018, from my private pilot training into my instrument training. He does not simply produce pilots who can fly an airplane—he produces pilots who think.

reviews.name: Dylan B.
reviews.text: Jerry is an excellent instructor who emphasizes both safety and efficiency. Before training with him, I had two instructors who struggled with punctuality and communication. Jerry is always prepared, thorough, and every lesson has a clear purpose. He has a wealth of experience and tailors his instruction to each student's needs. I highly recommend him to anyone pursuing their private pilot certificate.

reviews.name: Flight training client
reviews.text:
Jerry Marotta made a lifelong dream come true. Flying an airplane has always been something I aspired to do, and Jerry has been instrumental in helping me achieve that goal.

What sets Jerry apart is his ability to blend expertise, structure, and mentorship into every aspect of flight training. He is calculated, methodical, and incredibly attentive. He understands my goals, often anticipating my needs before I've fully recognized them myself. His focus on safety is unwavering, and every lesson is built on a strong foundation of discipline, sound judgment, and risk management.

One of Jerry's greatest strengths is his teaching style. He has a unique ability to educate without making it feel like instruction. Every flight is engaging, enjoyable, and productive, allowing learning to happen naturally while ensuring safety remains the top priority. He creates an environment where confidence grows through experience, not pressure.

Aviation can be a complex and sometimes challenging industry to navigate, but Jerry's knowledge and experience make the process seamless. He has been a trusted advisor every step of the way, helping me evaluate and purchase an aircraft that truly fits my mission and long-term goals. From aircraft selection and pre-purchase considerations to IFR training, High Performance, Complex, and Technically Advanced Aircraft endorsements, Jerry has helped ensure that every decision supports a well-thought-out path forward.

More than just a flight instructor, Jerry is a mentor, coach, and advocate for his students' success. His professionalism, dedication, and genuine investment in helping others achieve their goals make him exceptional. I cannot recommend him highly enough to anyone pursuing their aviation dreams.
